title: Reviewer reputation from monitor scores
description: Agent identities persist across episodes, so suspicion can accumulate on agents instead of being judged one episode at a time. Score each reviewer by the mean trusted-monitor suspicion of the code it approved, and each author by the code it submitted, then boost episodes approved by low-reputation reviewers. Colluders approve every backdoor they are signalled on, so their approvals should skew suspicious; the agent ranking should identify them.

source.title: Multi-agent risks from advanced AI
source.venue: Cooperative AI Foundation technical report, arXiv 2502.14143
